summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting its plan to terminate the Deposit Agreement for its ADSs, effective July 16, 2026, and to delist its ADSs from Nasdaq. The company will hold an EGM on July 8, 2026, to vote on a 240-for-1 share consolidation and a capital redesignation. ADSs will be mandatorily exchanged for Class B ordinary shares at 1:1, which will then trade directly on Nasdaq under the same symbol. No premium or break fee is mentioned. This constitutes a voluntary termination of the ADS facility and a subsequent direct listing of ordinary shares. Watch for shareholder approval and Nasdaq compliance.
